Some advice for basic altering... If you can use an overlock machine, it will help alterations go a lot faster (cuts excess, sews seam, and overlocks edge all in one go). Otherwise, if you're taking in a sweater's sides for example, mark it and sew it with a straight stitch first, then cut down the excess and zig-zag it.
